task: Estimate the specified flue-gas emission concentration of a gas turbine from operating and ambient measurements.
context: AT: ambient Celsius; AP: ambient mbar; AH: percent humidity; AFDP: filter differential pressure mbar; GTEP: exhaust pressure mbar; TIT/TAT: inlet/after-turbine Celsius; CDP: compressor discharge pressure mbar; TEY: source hourly energy yield in MWh. Both pollutant target columns are excluded from input. Measurements are contemporaneous.
